description_en: Retrieves the details of user logs in log management
description_zh: 获取日志管理中用户日志详情
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-data-storage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDataStorage

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center for threat analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.

Note: This parameter is required in actual API calls. If this parameter is not provided, the service returns a 400 error "The specified Lang can not be empty." Explicitly pass the language code
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。

注意：此参数在实际调用中为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误 “The specified Lang can not be empty.”，请显式传入语言代码
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

DataStorageRegionPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the storage region can be modified. By default, the storage region cannot be modified. To reset the region, contact the product manager. The region can be reset only once. Valid values:
allow: The storage region can be modified.
deny: The storage region cannot be modified
DataStorageRegionPermission.description_zh:
是否可以修改存储地域。默认不可以，联系产品经理可以进行地域重置并且只能重置一次。取值：
allow：可以修改。
deny：不可以修改

LogDeliveryPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether you are allowed to enable or disable log delivery. Log delivery is unavailable if the service is not purchased. Valid values:
allow: Allowed.
deny: Not allowed
LogDeliveryPermission.description_zh:
是否允许操作日志投递开关，未购买的情况下无法进行投递。取值：
allow：允许。
deny：不允许

LogDeliveryStatus.description_en:

enable: Log delivery is enabled.
